quote.text: Either we should not pray at all, or thus absolutely and freely; and not every one for himself in particular alone.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace the idea that nurturing your child goes beyond individual needs—guide them to understand the value of selfless care and communal support, much like free and wholehearted prayer.
    • Instill in them the virtue of considering the family as a whole; in doing so, you teach that actions (and prayers) should not be isolated but rather aimed at the collective well-being.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, recognize that your guidance and decisions should always serve the greater good, mirroring the concept of offering unreserved and inclusive prayers rather than focusing solely on personal ambitions.
    • Encourage a unified vision where all members contribute towards shared goals—this collective spirit strengthens the team and fosters an environment of mutual respect and trust.
  • Product Management:
    • Approach product development with a mindset that values openness and communal input, much like praying freely for a universal benefit rather than catering to a singular user or stakeholder.
    • Foster a culture of collaboration and inclusivity, ensuring that every decision made enhances the product’s value for all users, not just a select few, embodying a truly comprehensive vision.
